display.purpose: Mood labels and large status text on emotion screen.

label.purpose: Tab labels, badges, metadata, compact UI text.

mono.purpose: Timestamps, queue track numbers, technical indicators.

motion.name: snappy
motion.purpose: Fast UI interactions: button taps, tab switches, hovers, dot state changes.

motion.name: smooth
motion.purpose: Content transitions: theme changes, image crossfades, blur.

motion.name: lyrics-spring
motion.purpose: Lyrics line transitions: scroll, fade, depth-of-field.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Capsule button with theme accent fill. Used for primary actions (import playlist).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF8038; color: #fff; padding: 14px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF8038; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Floating surface container with subtle border. Used for config sections, cluster panels.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #231A16; color: #D9D9D9; padding: 28px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(217,217,217,0.10); } .ds-card h3 { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 12px 0; } .ds-card p { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0; color: #666666; }

components.name: Pill Badge
components.description: Compact capsule indicator. Active state uses accent fill.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #FF8038; color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pill--inactive { background: #231A16; color: #6B4F3A; }

components.name: Tab Pill
components.description: Individual tab item in the top tab bar. Capsule shape with sliding selection.
components.css: .ds-tab-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #6B4F3A; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-tab-pill:hover { color: #D9D9D9; } .ds-tab-pill--active { background: rgba(255,128,56,0.20); color: #FF8038; }

components.name: Dot Matrix Dot
components.description: Individual circle in the 9x5 dot matrix grid. Active dots glow with trail palette color.
components.css: .ds-dot-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; } .ds-dot { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3E2D24; opacity: 0.6; transition: background 0.25s ease, opacity 0.25s ease; } .ds-dot--active { background: #FF8038; opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Player Indicator
components.description: Subtle status text below the emotion screen (playing/paused).
components.css: .ds-player-indicator { height: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: #666666; }

narrative.overview:
Cella's visual system is a control surface that breathes. Dark, focused backgrounds host soft floating surfaces that respond to music — the dot matrix pulses, the line visualizer trails, and the color palette shifts entirely between themes. Each theme (Dark, Seafoam, Bipolar) is a distinct personality, not a recolor; the system is chameleon by design.

The aesthetic is nocturnal precision meets organic warmth: deep, near-black backgrounds with carefully calibrated accent colors that feel alive when music flows. Components float above the darkness — soft-edged, gently bounded, never heavy. The dot matrix display is the emotional core: a 9x5 grid of circles that animate between states with spring physics, reacting to player state, mood, and analysis data.
keyCharacteristics: Three chameleon themes that transform personality, not just palette
Soft floating surfaces with subtle borders over near-black depth
Reactive dot matrix as emotional feedback center
Spring-based motion language (snappy for UI, smooth for content)
High contrast accent on dark — accents appear only when music flows

rules.name: The Chameleon Rule
rules.body: Theme switching replaces the entire color world — accent, surface, text, halo, trail. Never mix colors across themes.

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The theme accent color appears on 15% or less of any given screen. Its glow is the point.

rules.name: The Silent Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Typography establishes order but never calls attention to itself. Weight and size do the work.

rules.name: The Center-Stage Rule
rules.body: The emotion screen occupies the visual center and the majority of screen real estate. Everything else orbits it.

rules.name: The Floating Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards float above the background via color lift alone. No shadows.

rules.name: The Soft Boundary Rule
rules.body: Every bounded element has a visible corner radius. Nothing is sharp-edged except thin dividers.

dos: Do keep the emotion screen as the visual center
Do use the full theme palette when switching themes
Do use capsule shape for all interactive elements
Do use spring animations (snappy for UI, smooth for content)
Do keep accent color scarce — it should glow, not flood
Do use tonal layering for depth — never shadows
donts: Don't use drop shadows or elevation artifacts
Don't use sharp corners on any bounded element
Don't compete with the emotion screen
Don't use accent color for large background fills
